preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50 for n, s, k in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the number of elements n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 200 for n, s, k in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the sum of elements s is between 0 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 2000 for n, s, k in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the sum of absolute differences k is between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, list) and len(result) == n for result, (n, s, k) in zip(results, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query, the result is a list of n non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(result) == s for result, (n, s, k) in zip(results, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query, the sum of the elements in the result is equal to s.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(abs(result[i] - result[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)) == k for result, (n, s, k) in zip(results, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query, the sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements in the result is equal to k.

postconditions.expression: all(all(result[i] <= result[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1)) for result, (n, s, k) in zip(results, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query, the result is lexicographically smallest.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result == -1 for result, (n, s, k) in zip(results, queries) if not (sum(result) == s and sum(abs(result[i] - result[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)) == k))
postconditions.description: If no valid array exists, the result is -1.
